messages:
mira: FYI our Next/Edge sample failed on Vercel after switching the monorepo to pnpm (isolated linker). Node builds OK but edge build errors with 'Package "@redwood/sdk" has no export named "./runtime/edge"'.

joel: that screams pnpm symlink + bundler exports mismatch. esbuild (used by vercel) can resolve files under the symlink target and then miss package subpath exports.

mira: SDK package.json has an explicit subpath export for ./runtime/edge. consumer does `import { createEdgeHandler } from '@redwood/sdk/runtime/edge'`.

sam: quick repro: monorepo w/ packages/sdk and apps/web, pnpm install (isolated), cd apps/web, pnpm run build -> esbuild fails to find export. switching to node-linker=hoisted fixes it locally.

tia: two pragmatic workarounds: 1) add a small root-level proxy file (runtime-edge.js) that re-exports the built file and expose it in exports as './runtime-edge' so consumers import '@redwood/sdk/runtime-edge'; 2) document pnpm node-linker=hoisted recommended for CI building edge apps.

mira: adding proxy file seems lowest friction for users. I'll open a tiny PR on examples to switch the sample app import to runtime-edge and add a note in the README.

joel: also worth adding a troubleshooting section in devex: commands to reproduce and quick fixes. include this snippet:

```bash
# reproduce
pnpm i
cd apps/web
pnpm run build # see esbuild export error
# diagnostic
node -e "console.log(require.resolve('@redwood/sdk/package.json'))"
# test hoisted mode
echo 'node-linker=hoisted' > .npmrc
pnpm install --force
pnpm --filter apps/web run build
```

sam: filed a local repro and will push steps into the devex docs.

ci-bot: ran preview build for examples with both default pnpm and hoisted mode; proxy-import PR passes on preview. :white_check_mark:

tia: long-term we should test turborepo and yarn workspaces too and add a CI matrix for workspace manager permutations.

mira: will create follow-up issue to add matrix and docs. thanks all :pray:
